description: This PHP source file defines the BackupGatewayClient class for interacting with the AWS Backup Gateway service. It includes method annotations for various API operations such as creating, deleting, and listing gateways and hypervisors, indicating it serves as a client interface to AWS Backup Gateway.

classes.name: BackupGatewayClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient, used to interact with the AWS Backup Gateway service. It provides methods for managing gateways, hypervisors, virtual machines, and related resources.
